newsitem.title: LATVIA: CENTRAL BANK TO HOLD FIRST SWAP AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: CENTRAL BANK TO HOLD FIRST SWAP AUCTION.

text.p: The central bank said on Wednesday that it will hold its first swap auction.
Elena Zubkova, head of the financial markets analysis division of the central bank's monetary policy department, said that banks can enter bids until 12 pm.
She said the type of auction was "S", when the central bank provides banks with lats and they deposit dollars.
"We are going to organise a swap auction. It is the first one," Zubkova told Reuters.
The maturity is 91-days, the spot date for lats is July 11 and the forward date for lats is October 10, she said.
The spot date for dollars is July 10 and the forward date for dollars is October 10.
The Bank of Latvia's spot rate for the dollar is 0.5694 and the dollar interest rate is 5.58 percent, she added.
Zubkova said that so far only two banks have signed agreements with the central bank to take part in the auction.
"If one bank participates then the auction will take place," she said.
The results of the auction will be known around one pm.
